svg.text: Agents write facts. Only the engine sets a status.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Every source writes facts in one shape (key, value, source, strength, time). The deterministic engine turns facts into findings. Every output reads findings.
No model can move a status.
